about_the_game:
A 2D fast-paced platformer with action elements and cartoon-style graphics. As a Reptilian, you must traverse numerous levels, avoid traps, and battle enemies along the way. Your goal is to rescue your fellow tribesmen and defeat the evil corporation that seeks to enslave your home planet!

Story

On a distant planet at the edge of the galaxy, a friendly reptilian race lived in peace. Everything was perfect until suddenly, humans from Astra Chemical Corp arrived. The corporation began mining an acid-rich mineral used as an energy source for industrial production and interstellar travel. The Reptilians were enslaved and forced to work in the mines.

However, mining soon became difficult and expensive. The corporation then found another solution—extracting acid directly from the Reptilians, as their bodies consist of 95% acid.

One brave Reptilian discovered the corporation's sinister plans and decided to stop them at any cost and save his people from extinction!

Gameplay

The Reptilian can run, jump, dash, wall-kick, and climb on walls and ceilings. He can attack using claws and his tail, spit acid, and bite.

Using all these abilities, you must explore levels, overcome obstacles, and avoid traps. Each level presents small challenges: find and collect all batteries, which serve as keys to doors, or defeat enemies and rescue your trapped friends.

You can choose your own approach to dealing with the sinister corporation’s soldiers—jump down from the ceiling using stealth or engage them head-on with claws or acid attacks.

Local Co-op for Two Players

Game Features:

  • An engaging setting and agile main character

  • Cartoon-style graphics and animations, including animated cutscenes

  • Dynamic visual effects

  • Three difficulty levels

  • Atmospheric soundtrack

  • Local multiplayer for two players

short_description: In this 2D action platformer, you'll play as a humanoid reptile and save the planet and your people from an evil corporation! Reach the control center and activate the self-destruct mechanism! It won't be easy, as there are plenty of traps, obstacles, and heavily armed guards in your way!
